title: Mutt Carey's death and birthplace
summary: Russell and Duhé recall Mutt Carey, who died in 1948, and talk about his Hahnville origins and a recent parade there.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Mutt Cherry died up there, too. Yes, he died in 1948, I think, September of 1948. Sam was pretty good there.
I knew Mutt very well. Wonderful trumpet playing. His style of playing.
Mutt. I wanted to ask you a few questions about your life. I was from Hornville.

He was born right in the city. Weren't the Carey's, I think? Or were they from the country? No, he was born in Hornville. Oh, he was up there? Hornville, Louisiana. Oh, up there. We were up there for a parade.
Parade just about two weeks ago. Hornsville.
